All verification commands pass:

- `npm run build && node /tmp/vi-hint/check.mjs` → prints `ok`
- `node --test tests/host-prompt.integration.mjs tests/host-postprocess.integration.mjs` → 11/11 pass
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0

Changed paths:
- `host.ts` — `runTranscription` now builds `hint` solely from `buildRecognitionPrompt(entries, PROMPT_BUDGET_CHARS)` when `vocabularyPrompt` is on, else `null`; the `?? args.prompt` / `: args.prompt` fallbacks are gone, so composer text and BB's hint never reach the speech model. The RPC `prompt` field, `args.prompt`, and the silence/hallucination guard are unchanged.
- `tests/host-prompt.integration.mjs` — new harness test (same style as `host-postprocess.integration.mjs`, temp dir under `/tmp`) asserting all four vocabulary/toggle combinations against the captured multipart `prompt` field.

```plan-fact

  {"item":1,"status":"done","evidence":["host.ts:287-290","tests/host-prompt.integration.mjs:33-61","cmd:sh -c 'npm run build >/dev/null && node /tmp/vi-hint/check.mjs'"]},
  {"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["host.ts:287-290","tests/host-prompt.integration.mjs:46-58","cmd:sh -c 'npm run build >/dev/null && node --test tests/host-prompt.integration.mjs tests/host-postprocess.integration.mjs'"]},
  {"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["cmd:npx tsc --noEmit","host.ts:287-290"]}
]
```

APPROACH: Removed the `args.prompt` fallback in `runTranscription` so `hint` is `buildRecognitionPrompt(entries, PROMPT_BUDGET_CHARS)` when the toggle is on and `null` otherwise — one-line-shaped change, everything downstream (cloud request, daemon call, hallucination guard) already accepts `string | null`. Added `tests/host-prompt.integration.mjs` using `experimental_createHostEntryHarness` on `dist/host.js` with a fetch mock capturing `init.body.has("prompt")`/`get("prompt")`, covering empty vocabulary × toggle on/off and "DeepSeek, MLX" × toggle on/off.

LESSON: The same `runTranscription` hint feeds cloud engines, the local daemon, and the echo guard — fixing it at the single `hint` assignment covers every engine without touching per-engine code.
